policyholder_name.description: The business that makes the statement, with its legal form; never the insurer

period_start.description: The first day of the period stated, ISO YYYY-MM-DD

period_end.description: The last day of the period stated, ISO YYYY-MM-DD

claims_count.description: The total number of claims the statement gives, plain number STRING; 0 when it states none

claims_paid_total.description: The total paid on the claims, plain decimal STRING; 0 when it states none

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the statement's amounts (Ft = HUF)

claims.description: Every claim the statement lists, in the order printed; not a total row

claim_date.description: The day it happened, ISO YYYY-MM-DD

paid.description: The amount paid on it, plain decimal STRING
